summary.plain: A bubble chamber with two nested quartz jars, upright above its bellows so that no water touches the dark-matter target; cameras and microphones record each bubble.
summary.technical: Right-side-up design: two concentric nested quartz jars, bellows, mineral-oil hydraulic fluid, ~70 kg C3F8, a thermal system with a temperature gradient across the bellows, 4 cameras, 12 piezoelectric transducers, 2 Dytran pressure transducers; in the water tank of the former PICO-60 location at SNOLAB.

technology.quote: The new system involves two, concentric, nested quartz jars (see illustration below), oriented “right-side-up”, when compared to PICO-60.
technology.value: Right-side-up superheated C3F8 bubble chamber with two nested quartz jars, bellows and a temperature-graded thermal system
